title: DocArchiveReviewQueueSearchRequest v1
description: GET /document-archive/reviews query parameters (G2, D-247/D-24x, src/modules/document-archive/application/document-archive-service.ts ReviewQueueQuery). `state` is required and singular — mirrors the GSI5 sparse review-queue index's own per-state partitioning (reviewQueueGsi5PartitionKey), there is no server-side 'ALL' mode.
